findings.message: The required-section loop now skips the empty-body check for `## Goal / Why` on every `kind: graphics` ticket. The only replacement check is the lint rule 'generate render has no input or prompt', which runs only when `mode: generate`. So a `mode: command` graphics ticket with an empty `## Goal / Why` parses and lints with no finding. That is an unrequested loosening of a required section. The ticket only asks that a generate ticket with no input and no prompt yield a finding (criterion 7).
findings.paved_road: Skip the empty Goal / Why parse check only for generate-mode Render blocks, or keep the parse-time requirement for command mode (for example, check the parsed Render mode before skipping). Add a test that an empty Goal / Why on a `mode: command` graphics ticket still raises `TicketInvalid` or yields a finding.
